page.overview:
Who is Laurentius Daye?

Laurentius Daye is a non-playable character in Final Fantasy XIV. Once a crooked Wood Wailer caught selling information to the XIVth Imperial Legion, he later volunteers to join the Crystal Braves.

Laurentius never met his parents. His father vanished long before he was born, and his mother was slain by a bandit when he was but a boy. He joined the Wood Wailers with grand hopes of defending Gridania from within, but quickly alienated his brothers-in-arms by reporting their every violation—no matter how trivial—out of a mistaken sense of duty.

Once Laurentius was saved by Buscarron from a wild beast. Although Laurentius has become a regular customer at Buscarron's Druthers, he seems to have forgotten this incident, and Buscarron didn't have the courage to remind him. Feeling isolated, Laurentius often found himself at Buscarron's Druthers where he could find someone to speak to him.

Laurentius is first encountered during the search for the missing Frixio. Buscarron suspected him as a possible informant to the Garleans, due to his increased spending at his tavern. Since he was a Wood Wailer rather than a common merchant, this looked suspicious. With the Warrior of Light suddenly encountering Garleans outside Buscarron Druthers, he put two and two together and asked that Laurentius be investigated. Laurentius tried brushed off questions, but was eventually caught red-handed. With the surprising aid of Redbelly Bandits and Coeurlclaw Poachers, Laurentius realized that Buscarron was responsible and decided to turn himself in. He asks the Warrior of Light pass along a message to the tavernkeep - "thank you."
